app.name.note: Product brand name. Never translate or transliterate; see glossary.

nav.archive.note: Noun: the section that lists archived projects and tasks. Not the action of archiving.

actions.archive.note: Verb on a button: move the current task to the archive.

actions.save.note: Verb on a button: store the edited task. Not about saving money.

actions.open.note: Verb on a button: open the attached file. Not the task status.

actions.ok.note: Product style keeps Latin "OK" in every locale (glossary doNotTranslate).

dialog.close.note: Verb on a button: dismiss the dialog without changing anything. Not closing a task.

board.title.note: Noun: a kanban board of columns and cards. Not a board of directors, not a plank.

board.cardCount.description: Number of cards in one kanban column.

task.close.note: Verb on a button: mark the task resolved (finished). Not dismissing a dialog; the task stays visible.

task.watch.note: Verb on a toggle button: subscribe to notifications about this task. Not watching a video.

task.lead.note: Noun: field label for the person who leads the task. Not the metal, not a sales lead.

task.rank.description: Ordinal position of the task in the team's priority queue (1st, 2nd, ...).

status.open.note: Adjective describing a task (grammatical gender: task). Not a verb.

status.draft.note: Noun/adjective: the task is an unpublished draft. Not the verb "to draft", not a current of air.

feed.postButton.note: Verb on a button: publish the message the user has just written.

feed.postHeading.note: Noun: page heading for one published message. Not the verb "to post", not mail.

rooms.book.note: Verb on a button: reserve the selected meeting room. Not a book.

rooms.available.note: Adjective: the room is not occupied at that time (feminine if the locale genders "room"). Not "free of charge".

rooms.busy.note: Adjective: the room is occupied at that time.

library.book.note: Noun: a long-form document type in the knowledge base. Not the verb "to reserve".

automation.runNow.note: Verb on a button: execute this automation rule now.

automation.runHeader.note: Noun: column header; each row is one execution of the rule. Not a verb, not jogging.

search.matchCase.note: Checkbox label: make the search case-sensitive.

search.match.note: Verb label shown before a dropdown: "Match [all | any] of the following conditions". Not a sports match, not a matchstick.

search.results.description: Number of search hits (noun "match" = a hit), not a sports match.

billing.save.note: Verb: spend less money (discount). Not storing data.

billing.order.note: Noun: column header for the purchase order. Not a sort order, not a command.

sort.order.note: Noun: the sort order of cards (ascending/descending). Not a purchase order.

meeting.present.note: Verb on a button: start presenting your screen. Not attendance, not a gift.

meeting.attendancePresent.note: Adjective: the attendee is here. Not the verb "to present", not a gift.

settings.theme.note: Noun: visual appearance / colour scheme of the app. Not a topic or subject.

errors.sessionExpired.note: <link> wraps a sign-in link; keep the tag pair.

onboarding.welcome.note: Keep the brand TaskBoard as is.
